gate_c.abstention_rule: abstain unless absolute mean floor difference exceeds 2*sqrt(var0/n+var1/n)
gate_c.checkpoint_requirement: Serialize each exact opaque checkpoint, reload it on a fresh pinned adapter, verify adapter-bound exact native/public fingerprints before every forced legal action; if unsupported, block Gate C without substitutes.
gate_c.independence_claim: independent expert and uniform policy-sampling streams conditional on each persisted full-native-state root; no game-future RNG independence claim
gate_c.native_rng_resampling: none; each suffix restores identical GameContext/BattleContext RNG state. Only separately seeded expert/uniform policy decisions are resampled.
gate_c.root_selection: earliest roots in fixed seed/decision order; reserve earliest two distinct families; include earliest root with policy_decision_index >= 2; fill to four
gate_c.seed_derivation: sha256(issue73|gateC|suffix-or-expert|native_seed|run_id|root_index|candidate_index|replicate); first 64 bits masked to 63-bit positive integer; separate suffix and Expert tags
gate_c.uncertainty: Per-action sample variance and SE; unpaired Welch mean-difference SE; independent bootstrap percentile interval; empirical pairwise rank probability with ties half-weighted; predeclared two-SE abstention.

stage0.pi_suffix: 0.80 expert_non_combat_v1 + 0.20 uniform over all currently legal actions at each multichoice
stage0.root_collection_stop: At least 24 valid multichoice roots across four distinct families plus MAP hidden, TREASURE RNG, and third-family post-two witness; otherwise exhaust the fixed eight debug seeds. No seed reruns.
stage0.root_selection_rule: roots sorted by debug seed then categorical decision index; first four distinct screen families first, then fill to 24 with earliest remaining roots

synthetic_target.loss: mean cross entropy over 24 roots, one fixed target occurrence/root
synthetic_target.target: argmax candidate dot fixed unit direction over corrected-encoder features
